summary.intent: Fix the `entire summary <checkpoint-id>` command which returned no results when called with a checkpoint ID from the main branch, even though the same checkpoint was visible in the TUI.
summary.outcome: Identified and fixed a branch-filter bug in summary_cmd.go where the current branch name was passed to the TUI even when a specific checkpoint ID was provided, causing cross-branch checkpoints to be silently filtered out. All 3 tests pass and the fix was committed.

repo: The summary TUI filters rows by branch name at summarytui/root.go:480; passing an empty string disables this filter.
When a checkpoint prefix/ID is explicitly provided by the user, the branch filter should be bypassed entirely since the user has made an explicit selection.

code.finding: Bug location: currentBranch was passed unconditionally to the TUI; fix passes empty string when a checkpoint prefix is provided to disable branch filtering.
Branch name filter is applied here; empty string disables it.

workflow: Lint errors in unrelated files should not block a targeted fix; verify lint errors are not in changed files before investigating further.
The fix involved passing empty string to disable an existing filter rather than adding new conditional logic — leveraging existing behavior.

friction: Lint errors appeared during the lint check but were not in the changed files, requiring verification that they were pre-existing and unrelated.
